info.name: LEAP_calorimeter
info.title: LEAP calorimeter (single cell)
info.author: translated from leap_sims/src/Calorimeter.cc
info.comment: Minimal DD4hep translation of the LEAP lead glass calorimeter: one single cell, i.e. a lead glass crystal in an air gap in an aluminium wrapping, and nothing else. See src/LEAPCalorimeter_geo.cpp for the list of things that are meant to be added on top of this one step at a time.

define.comment: The DetType_* constants used in the type_flag below
The world. The original uses a 4 m half side box of air, and DD4hep fills the world with air as well.

Extent of the "tracker region". ddsim's default UserParticleHandler needs these two constants for the MC truth linking, so they have to exist even though there is no tracker in this setup yet. Covering the whole world keeps every particle in the MC truth relation.
Calorimeter cell parameters, cf. Calorimeter::ConstructCalo(). These are the *primitive* numbers only; the air gap and wrapping dimensions are derived from them by the detector constructor.

Position of the cell in the world. The original places the calorimeter [Calorimeter] dist2Pol behind the solenoid, which does not exist in this translation yet, so the value below is arbitrary: it simply puts the front face of the cell at z = 0.

display.comment: Colours as in the G4VisAttributes of the original

detector.name: LEAPCal
detector.comment: Reflective aluminium foil wrapped around the crystal
Air gap between crystal and wrapping, on the front face and the sides
The lead glass crystal. caloMaterial = TF1 in the original config.ini

readout.name: LEAPCalHits
readout.comment: A single crystal, so there is nothing to encode but the system id
